gap.reason: Stage 2 decomposition critic repair: The source boundary is field-specific: HCPs must not view a patient's password or security question. The proposed atom substitutes a broader proxy that forbids HCP viewCredential access to Patient resources generally because the schema lacks a way to distinguish which credential field is being viewed. That proxy is too broad for the source excerpt and should not be accepted as equivalent. Repair the schema/property to expose the missing field-level credential boundary, such as a credential-field selector or separate actions/resources for password and securityQuestion viewing, then state the disjointness only for those patient credential fields.

proposed_atoms.name: viewCredential
proposed_atoms.rationale: Adds a field selector so policies can distinguish viewing a patient's password from viewing a patient's security question.
proposed_atoms.plain_english_summary: This lets authorization rules know exactly which credential field someone is trying to view.
proposed_atoms.source_excerpt: The HCP must not enter, edit, or view the patient's security question or password.

credentialField.name: viewCredential__context__credentialField
credentialField.rationale: Identifies the specific credential field being viewed so field-specific prohibitions can be expressed.
credentialField.plain_english_summary: The request says whether the viewer is trying to see the password or the security question.
credentialField.source_excerpt: The HCP must not enter, edit, or view the patient's security question or password.

gap.reason: Stage 2 decomposition critic repair: The administrator hospital-assignment workflow is materially useful and not already covered by the approved creation/credential atoms, but the source requirement includes a named boundary: the assigned hospital must be chosen from the hospital list. The proposed floor omits that condition and would require permission for any context.hospital of type Hospital, using the entity type as a proxy for hospital-list membership. The validated schema has no explicit HospitalList entity, list-membership attribute, or equivalent hook to represent this boundary, so the property should not be accepted until the schema/property can express the hospital-list membership constraint.

proposed_atoms.name: HospitalList
proposed_atoms.rationale: Models the authoritative set of hospitals that can be selected during LHCP hospital assignment.
proposed_atoms.plain_english_summary: The official list of hospitals an administrator is allowed to choose from when assigning an LHCP to hospitals.
proposed_atoms.source_excerpt: An administrator can assign an LHCP to multiple hospitals, choosing only hospitals from the hospital list.

proposed_atoms.name: HospitalList__hospitals
proposed_atoms.rationale: Stores the hospitals that are members of the approved hospital list for assignment checks.
proposed_atoms.plain_english_summary: The hospitals included in the official hospital list.
proposed_atoms.source_excerpt: An administrator can assign an LHCP to multiple hospitals, choosing only hospitals from the hospital list.
alternatives_considered: Hospital__isInHospitalList: Bool was rejected because the requirement names a hospital list rather than a standalone flag on each hospital.
Hospital__hospitalList: HospitalList was rejected because the assignment check only needs membership in the authoritative list.
Using the Hospital entity type as the list boundary was rejected because it cannot distinguish listed hospitals from other Hospital entities.

proposed_atoms.name: assignHospital
proposed_atoms.rationale: Adds the hospital-list context needed to verify that the assigned hospital is chosen from the approved hospital list.
proposed_atoms.plain_english_summary: An administrator assigns an LHCP to a hospital, with the request carrying the official hospital list to check against.
proposed_atoms.source_excerpt: An administrator can assign an LHCP to multiple hospitals, choosing only hospitals from the hospital list.

session.name: assignHospital__context__session
session.rationale: Preserves the existing authenticated-session requirement for this protected action.
session.plain_english_summary: The active login session for the administrator making the assignment.
session.source_excerpt: An administrator can assign an LHCP to multiple hospitals, choosing only hospitals from the hospital list.

hospital.name: assignHospital__context__hospital
hospital.rationale: Identifies the hospital being assigned to the LHCP.
hospital.plain_english_summary: The hospital the administrator wants to assign to the LHCP.
hospital.source_excerpt: An administrator can assign an LHCP to multiple hospitals, choosing only hospitals from the hospital list.

hospitalList.name: assignHospital__context__hospitalList
hospitalList.rationale: Provides the authoritative list used to check that the selected hospital is allowed.
hospitalList.plain_english_summary: The official hospital list that the selected hospital must come from.
